80654.subject: Don’t feel sorry for millennials. They’re living it up now
80654.body:

 The Economist

https://click.e.economist.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMjZ9AAcAAAAAB7_3btRMm_hWOengCKzBhAosi-eTLYGIzTKcAhrsbsb1dSgDaAvfeyYGYkmeNJ1KxC38y6h_bumaPkP2lP10OTN5edK-8dUZVleF4zSU21E 


 


 
 

Em Hogan

Senior digital editor



 I am a millennial, and am used to hearing all sorts of grumbles from my fellow cohort of 30-somethings about how hard life is. But it turns out those complaints are overstated, in rich countries at least. Many millennials are out-earning their parents. Growing numbers occupy positions of power. Home-ownership is rising fast. As my colleague writes: 
 
https://click.e.economist.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMjZ9AAcAAAAAB7_3btRNww_ydXNdTnGkbFvRzoVvq621pIKZHSYoKAp5a9BmLTc0BKw-GBYBwzhmXVPar1_r5HekbB2GjpbGMq12WuMVKKs5AatB9Q 
don’t feel sorry for us .
